EVAL-F-003-S1.title: Define External Research Link Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-003-S1.description: Define a structured schema for external provider research links including source (Healthgrades, NPI Registry, State Board), URL, label, and guidance text to support user interpretation.

EVAL-F-003-S2.title: Implement External Research Link Generation Logic
EVAL-F-003-S2.description: Generate provider-specific links for Healthgrades, NPI Registry, and supported state medical boards using NPI and provider metadata, including human-readable guidance text.

EVAL-F-003-S3.title: Normalize and Deduplicate External Research Links
EVAL-F-003-S3.description: Normalize generated URLs (protocol, trailing slashes, parameters) and remove duplicates across sources to ensure a clean, non-redundant link set before downstream delivery.

EVAL-F-003-S4.title: Expose External Research Links via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-003-S4.description: Integrate structured and validated research links into the provider detail response returned by evaluate_care_facade for downstream UI rendering.

EVAL-F-003-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for External Research Links
EVAL-F-003-S5.description: Create tests validating link generation accuracy, schema compliance, normalization/deduplication behavior, and end-to-end delivery through the evaluate care facade.
